scripts.script:
-- 1. Interface Arc-en-ciel
local s = Instance.new("ScreenGui", game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui)
local p = Instance.new("Frame", s) p.Size = UDim2.new(0,200,0,250) p.Position = UDim2.new(0.1,0,0.1,0)
task.spawn(function() while task.wait() do for i=0,1,0.01 do p.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromHSV(i,1,1) task.wait(0.02) end end end)

local function btn(txt, y, f)
    local b = Instance.new("TextButton", p) b.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,40) b.Position = UDim2.new(0,0,0,y) b.Text = txt
    b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(f)
end

-- Option 1: Voler (Toggle)
local v = false
btn("Voler", 10, function()
    v = not v local bp = p.Parent.Parent.Character.HumanoidRootPart:FindFirstChild("VolBP") or Instance.new("BodyPosition", p.Parent.Parent.Character.HumanoidRootPart)
    bp.Name = "VolBP" bp.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e5,1e6,1e5)
    task.spawn(function() while v do bp.Position = p.Parent.Parent.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position + Vector3.new(0,5,0) task.wait(0.1) end bp:Destroy() end)
end)

-- Option 2: Auto Chop Trees (Téléporte les arbres en l'air et coupe)
btn("Auto Chop Trees", 60, function()
    local hrp = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart
    hrp.CFrame = hrp.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 50, 0) -- Te met en l'air
    for _, t in pairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
        if t.Name == "Tree" or t:FindFirstChild("Wood") then -- Ajuste le nom selon tes modèles d'arbres
            t:MoveTo(hrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0, 5))
            -- Remplace "Hache" par le nom exact de ton outil de coupe
            local axe = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Hache") or game.Players.LocalPlayer.Backpack:FindFirstChild("Hache")
            if axe then axe.Parent = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character axe:Activate() end
            task.wait(0.2)
        end
    end
end)

-- Option 3: Amener des trucs (Aspirateur d'items)
btn("Amener Trucs (Logs)", 110, function()
    local hrp = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart
    for _, item in pairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
        if item.Name == "Log" or item.Name == "Wood" then -- Téléporte tous les morceaux de bois au sol vers toi
            if item:IsA("BasePart") then item.CFrame = hrp.CFrame
            elseif item:IsA("Model") then item:MoveTo(hrp.Position) end
        end
    end
end)

-- Option 4: Sauver les Enfants au Feu de Camp
btn("Ramasser Enfants", 160, function()
    local hrp = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart
    local sac = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Backpack
    
    for _, enf in pairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
        if enf.Name == "Enfant" then -- Ajuste le nom de tes PNJ enfants
            hrp.CFrame = enf.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame + Vector3.new(0,2,0) task.wait(0.3)
            enf.Parent = sac -- Met l'enfant symboliquement dans l'inventaire/sac
        end
    end
    
    -- Téléportation finale au feu de camp
    local feu = workspace:FindFirstChild("FeuDeCamp") -- Ajuste le nom du feu de camp dans ton workspace
    if feu then
        hrp.CFrame = feu.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0)
    end
end)

Freeze Enemies (Toggle): Freezes nearby enemies in place, preventing them from moving or attacking.
Auto Fueling (Toggle): Automatically refuels generators, vehicles, and other fuel-powered objects.
God Mode (Toggle): Makes your character invincible to nearly all damage sources.
Block Damage (Toggle): Prevents incoming damage while maintaining normal character movement.
Max Resources (Button): Instantly fills your available resources to their maximum value.
Rescue Children (Toggle): Automatically finds and rescues children across the map.
Fly (WASD + Space/Ctrl) (Toggle): Enables full 3D flight with keyboard controls.
Server Hop (Button): Instantly leaves the current server and joins a new available server.

scripts.title: Pearl 99 nights
scripts.features:
​🌲 99 Nights in the Forest | Ultimate Automated Script 🌲

​Dominate the wilderness and survive every single night effortlessly with this feature-rich, fully optimized script. Designed for maximum efficiency, safety, and combat dominance!

​⚔️ Combat & Kill Features

​Auto Bring & Kill Enemies: Automatically teleports all nearby mobs directly to you and eliminates them instantly.

​Kill Aura: Automatically attacks any hostile creature that gets within your vicinity.

​Safe Mode: Smart toggles to prevent bans and keep your farming looking natural to other players.

​🍎 Automation & Survival

​Bring Item: Instantly pulls valuable items and resources across the map directly to your inventory.

​Auto Cook All Meat: Automatically cooks every piece of meat available on the map—no manual campfire waiting required!

​Auto Eat Food: Keeps your hunger bar fully optimized so you never starve.

​Teleport to Campfire: Instantly escape danger or warm up by teleporting to the nearest campfire.

​🕊️ Movement & Exploits

​Walkspeed Slider: Customize your movement speed exactly how you want it.

​Jump Height Slider: Adjust your jump power to scale mountains and obstacles with ease.

​No Clip: Walk straight through trees, rocks, and walls.

​Fly: Take to the skies to scout the forest or avoid ground threats completely.

​👁️ Visuals & Utility

​ESP Mobs: See the exact location of every enemy through walls and across long distances.

​Anti-AFK: Prevents Roblox from disconnecting you, allowing you to farm resources overnight.
